title: NPC
description: REOSERV data/pub/npcs/<id>.json — one record per file. Combines EnfRecord plus drop, talk, and per-NPC rate overrides (drops loaded by src/utils/load_drop_file.rs, talk by load_talk_file.rs, rates by load_npc_rates_file.rs).

x-aio-groups.label: Rates
x-aio-groups.description: Per-NPC cadence overrides loaded by load_npc_rates_file.rs.

x-aio-groups.label: Level + XP
x-aio-groups.description: NPC level + per-NPC XP multiplier. XP grant = base_npc_xp × level_curve(level) × exp_multiplier × party_share × kill_eff.xp_gain. base_npc_xp lives in Config.toml. The legacy EO `experience` field is ignored — designers tune via level + multiplier.

x-aio-groups.label: Rarity override
x-aio-groups.description: Per-NPC drop-rarity distribution. When set, replaces the global rarity_weights.json for this NPC's drops. Leave absent to use the global. Use for bosses that should skew toward higher rarities.

behavior_id.description: Behavior id used by shops/inns/skill_masters/etc. to bind to this NPC.

element_weakness.description: Element this NPC is weak to.

drops.description: Item drop table (load_drop_file.rs). Empty = NPC drops nothing.

rate.description: Drop chance as a percentage. Stored as integer 0..=64000 rolled against a 64000-sided die.

talk_messages.description: Random ambient lines this NPC speaks (load_talk_file.rs). Empty = silent.

talk_rate.description: Talk chance roll (load_talk_file.rs). 0 with non-empty talk_messages = unused; lift before shipping.

attack_rate_ms.description: Per-NPC attack cadence in milliseconds (load_npc_rates_file.rs). Defaults to 1000 if absent.

move_rate_ms.description: Per-NPC movement cadence in milliseconds (load_npc_rates_file.rs). Defaults to 1500 if absent.

reputation_grant.description: Reputation points granted to the killer per kill (load_npc_rates_file.rs). Defaults to 1 if absent.

level.title: Level
level.description: NPC level (1..50). Drives XP scaling — level 25 grants ~3.4× the curve's base XP, level 50 ~5.9×. Will also drive item-level on drops once Phase 4 wires the drop path. Defaults to 1 if absent.

exp_multiplier.title: XP multiplier
exp_multiplier.description: Per-NPC fine-tune on the level-scaled XP grant. 1.0 = exactly what the curve says; 1.5 = 50% more (story or boss NPCs); 0.5 = half (filler or weak NPCs). Multiplies on top of level_curve(level). Defaults to 1.0 if absent.

rarity_override.title: Rarity override
rarity_override.description: Per-NPC drop-rarity weights. When present, replaces the global rarity_weights.json for THIS NPC's drops. Numbers should sum to 1.0. Leave the entire object absent to use the global default — adding an empty object will cause the server to skip it on next reload.

common.title: Common
common.description: Probability of a common drop from this NPC.

rare.title: Rare
rare.description: Probability of a rare drop from this NPC.

epic.title: Epic
epic.description: Probability of an epic drop from this NPC.

legendary.title: Legendary
legendary.description: Probability of a legendary drop from this NPC.
